Messages.Author: Wayne Duyvestyn
Messages.Body:
When The Embrace has been burnt, does it go into a vampire ash heap or just
into your library ash heap?

I ask in regards to such cards as Possession and Mark of the Damned.

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:


Library's ash heap. It's only a vampire while it is in play.

Sorrow

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Wayne Duyvestyn wrote:
> When The Embrace has been burnt, does it go into a vampire ash heap or just
> into your library ash heap?

There's only one ash heap (per player). It goes in that one.

> I ask in regards to such cards as Possession and Mark of the Damned.

The card is only a vampire/minion while in play.
In the ash heap (or library or hand), it is just an action card.
